title_zh: 选择不参加仪式的寺庙导览

scenario.label_zh: 选择不参加仪式的寺庙导览
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清语音导览是在介绍当地信仰，并选定只参观开放庭院而不参加仪式

context_zh: 虚构旅行场景：访客询问寺庙导览内容与可自由选择的参观范围。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: The audio guide mentions the soul leaving the body. Is the tour asking visitors to accept that belief?

sentences.speaker: Guide Arun
sentences.text: No. It's explaining one belief associated with this temple, not telling visitors what they must believe.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: I'm interested in its spiritual importance, but I don't want to take part in a ceremony.

sentences.speaker: Guide Arun
sentences.text: That's fine. The public tour stays in the open courtyard. Joining the ceremony is a separate choice.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Then I'll take the courtyard tour and skip the ceremony.

sentences.speaker: Guide Arun
sentences.text: Of course. Meet me beside the information board at two.
